tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than January 1, 2010, the head of each Federal agency shall install at least 1 renewable fuel pump at each Federal fleet fueling center in the United States under the jurisdiction of the head of the Federal agency.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than October 31 of the first calendar year beginning after December 19, 2007, and each October 31 thereafter, the President shall submit to Congress a report that describes the progress toward complying with subsection (a), including identifying—

children.text: the number of Federal fleet fueling centers that contain at least 1 renewable fuel pump; and
the number of Federal fleet fueling centers that do not contain any renewable fuel pumps.

tree.heading: Department of Defense facility
tree.text: This section shall not apply to a Department of Defense fueling center with a fuel turnover rate of less than 100,000 gallons of fuel per year.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary to carry out this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.

ancestors.heading: ENERGY SECURITY THROUGH INCREASED PRODUCTION OF BIOFUELS
